structuredContent.description: A single broad low ancient stone dais with an EMPTY central diamond socket, for a melancholy top-down pixel art game. Native128x80 pixels, entire raised plinth on transparent background. The whole prop fits canvas with a small clear margin. Two low shallow elliptical tiers of worn blue-grey massive stone blocks, wider than tall, front elevation only12pixels deep. Visible broad flat upper surface at a three-quarter top-down view. Huge weathered geometric engineering, restrained sharply faceted quiet areas, small chips only at stress corners, an empty DARK square-diamond recess at back center where a prism once stood. No idol, no crystal, no glow, no glyphs, no decorative circles, no spikes or columns, no grass. Upper-left cool light, dark right faces; mostly #46526a #333b4c #2b3548 with sparse #64738a rim highlights, never white. No ground or cast shadow. Hard pixel clusters and clean silhouette; negative space socket is focal detail.
